deliverable.says: One deliverable is one ticket resolved. A ticket reopened inside the window is the same deliverable, not a new one. There is one for each ticket.

evidence.says: No evidence source exists for this kind of work yet: nothing a third party signs says it was done.

checks.authority: none yet: the help desk's own record, which the seller keeps
checks.says: Nothing can decide yet: no third party signs that this work was done. The authoritative copy: none yet: the help desk's own record, which the seller keeps.

window.says: Nothing can be paid, so nothing can be reopened.

changes.says: Any file may change. No path is protected. A contributor may add nothing outside that without the buyer's say.

dispute.says: No appeal can be heard yet: there is no evaluator to hear it.

evaluators.says: No evaluator can be named yet: nobody signs for this kind of work.

price.says: Would pay 1.00 test USDC for each accepted deliverable. Nothing can be funded on these terms yet.

deadline.says: The order is open for 14 days from funding, or less if the funder cancels, which takes 7 days' notice. A token presented after that is refused, and the money goes back to its funder.

policy.says: @acme may publish a new version. A version never changes: a change is the next version, with its own hash, and an order keeps the version it was funded on.
